text:
No hiring choice can be put forward from this run: the £400k/year salary limit was not checkable.

- All four options were compared provisionally, but each lacked an annual-salary-spend effect and was therefore analysed as leaving that factor unchanged. That directly undermines the budget question.
- The comparison is fragile, and every material estimate is machine-authored rather than user-validated. Incremental delivery capacity and onboarding load are particularly uncertain.
- The goal was also treated as “higher platform delivery is better”; that direction was not stated by you.

This is a model-relative first pass, not a decision.
